description: Redesign HomePage.tsx and AboutPage.tsx with full cinematic glassmorphic UI - full-screen background photos, dark overlays, and glassmorphic content panels.
steps: Rewrite src/pages/HomePage.tsx with: (a) Full-screen hero with fixed background image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506905925346-21bda4d32df4?w=1920&q=80, dark overlay gradient from rgba(0,0,0,0.7) to rgba(0,0,0,0.5), school name in large white text, tagline 'Nurturing Tribal Youth Through Quality Education'. (b) Stats strip in glass cards (fetch from /api/school/stats, fallback: 460 Students, 26 Staff, 12 Standards, 520 Hostel Beds). (c) Feature cards (Admission, AI Assistant, Parent Portal, WhatsApp Bot) in dark glass. (d) All text white/slate-300 with emerald-400 accents. (e) Entrance animations (fade in + slide up) using motion.

Rewrite src/pages/AboutPage.tsx with: (a) Fixed full-screen background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580582932707-520aed937b7b?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) School history, vision, mission in glass panels. (c) Principal info, staff count, department info in glass cards. (d) White headings, slate-300 body, emerald-400 accents. (e) Entrance animations on scroll.
Both pages must preserve the bilingual t(en, mr) pattern and use useAppContext for language.
Both pages must fetch /api/school/stats where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: HomePage has a full-screen hero with mountain background and dark overlay
HomePage shows stats in glassmorphic cards
HomePage has feature cards for Admission, AI Assistant, Parent Portal, WhatsApp Bot
AboutPage has cinematic background with glass panels for content
Both pages use white/slate-300 text with emerald accents
findings: Both pages rewritten successfully. Lint and build pass. Used Bot icon from lucide-react for AI Assistant card. Staff fallback set to 26 as specified. totalVillages added to stats state. The chunk size warning from vite build is pre-existing (>500kB JS bundle) and not caused by these changes.
